entries.odia: ପର ଲୁଗା ପିନ୍ଧି ଯାତକୁ ଯାଏ ଲୋକ ପଚାଲିଲେ ମୁଣ୍ଡ ଟୁଙ୍ଗାରୁ ଥାଏ
entries.title: Borrowed clothes and a nod
entries.literal_meaning: Provisional reading: wearing another’s clothes, someone goes to the fair; when people ask, the person keeps nodding.
entries.explanation: The line places another person’s clothing beside a nodding response. Our reading notices a gap between visible appearance and an answer left unspoken. It does not tell us what people ask, what the nod means, or whether the wearer intends to deceive. Receiving or borrowing clothing is not itself evidence of dishonesty.
entries.meaning_odia: ଅନ୍ୟର ଲୁଗା ପିନ୍ଧିବା ପାଖରେ ଧାଡ଼ିଟି ମୁଣ୍ଡ ଟୁଙ୍ଗାରିବାକୁ ରଖେ। ଉତ୍ସର ପଚାଲିଲେ ଶବ୍ଦରୂପ ଅବିକଳ ରହିଛି; ପଚାରିବା ସମ୍ବନ୍ଧୀୟ ଏହି ପାଠ ସମ୍ଭାବ୍ୟ। ଆମ ପାଠ ବାହାରକୁ ଦିଶୁଥିବା କଥା ଓ ଅକୁହା ଉତ୍ତର ମଧ୍ୟର ଫାଙ୍କ ଦେଖେ। ଲୋକେ କଣ ପଚାରିଲେ, ମୁଣ୍ଡ ଟୁଙ୍ଗାରିବାର ଅର୍ଥ କଣ, ବା ଠକିବା ଉଦ୍ଦେଶ୍ୟ ଥିଲା କି ନାହିଁ—କୁହାଯାଇନାହିଁ। ଅନ୍ୟର ଲୁଗା ନେବା ନିଜେ ଅସାଧୁତାର ପ୍ରମାଣ ନୁହେଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our reading leaves the nod’s meaning open rather than supplying a confession.
entries.odia_summary: ଆମ ପାଠ ମୁଣ୍ଡ ଟୁଙ୍ଗାରିବାର ଅର୍ଥ ଖୋଲା ରଖେ, ସ୍ୱୀକାରୋକ୍ତି ଗଢ଼େନାହିଁ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ନାଟକ ପାଇଁ ଲୁଗା ନେଇଥିବା ଜଣେ ଦର୍ଶକଙ୍କୁ କହିଲେ କିଏ ଦେଇଥିଲେ। ସହାୟତାର କଥା କହିବାରେ ତାଙ୍କର ଲଜ୍ଜା ନଥିଲା। / A performer acknowledges borrowed clothing openly. This response is invented.
entries.cultural_context: Sense1 is wearing clothes. Exact spelling is retained; no owner’s return, withdrawal, shame ending, wearer’s gender or verified fair custom is added.

entries.odia: ବୁଡ଼ ପାରିଲା କଥା ମୁଣ୍ଡ ଶୁଖେଇଲା ବେଳକୁ ନ ଥାଏ
entries.title: Gone before the head is dry
entries.literal_meaning: The matter of taking the dip is gone by the time the head is dried.
entries.explanation: The line measures a short interval through bathing and drying the head. The dictionary places it under the ordinary sense of bathing. Our reading follows how quickly a matter can cease to hold attention. The wording does not specify a promise, the words spoken during the bath, or why the matter no longer remains.
entries.meaning_odia: ଗାଧୋଇବା ଓ ମୁଣ୍ଡ ଶୁଖାଇବା ମଧ୍ୟର ଅଳ୍ପ ସମୟକୁ ଧାଡ଼ିଟି ଧରେ। ଅଭିଧାନରେ ଏହା ସାଧାରଣ ସ୍ନାନ ଅର୍ଥ ତଳେ ଅଛି। ଆମ ପାଠ ଦେଖେ, କେତେ ଶୀଘ୍ର ଗୋଟିଏ କଥା ଧ୍ୟାନରୁ ଚାଲିଯାଇପାରେ। କୌଣସି ପ୍ରତିଜ୍ଞା, ଗାଧୋଇବା ବେଳେ କୁହାଯାଇଥିବା ଶବ୍ଦ ବା କଥାଟି ଆଉ ନ ରହିବାର କାରଣ ଦିଆଯାଇନାହିଁ। ତେଣୁ ସେଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ଆମେ ଭରିଦେଉନାହୁଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our reading notices a brief hold on attention, without inventing a broken vow.
entries.odia_summary: ଆମ ପାଠ ଅଳ୍ପ ସମୟର ଧ୍ୟାନକୁ ଦେଖେ, ଭଙ୍ଗା ବ୍ରତର କଥା ଗଢ଼େନାହିଁ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ଆଲୋଚନାରେ ଉଠିଥିବା କାମଟି ଭୁଲି ନ ଯିବା ପାଇଁ ଦଳର ଜଣେ ସଭ୍ୟ ତାହା ଲେଖି ରଖିଲେ। / A group writes down a task so it is not lost after the discussion. This application is invented.
entries.cultural_context: The earlier religious-vow sense is separate. No ritual failure, hypocrisy, memory diagnosis or bathing efficacy is established; attention is an editorial application of the interval.
